title: Your details
helpNext: Provide your requested details first. When a document is offered, this page will open it for review and signing. Studio access requires separate approval.
introduction: Enter your invited email. We’ll send a one-time code.
boundary: Private agreement access only. Studio access requires approval.
codeIncomplete: Enter all eight digits from your email.
sent: Enter the code from your email.
unavailable: This invitation is unavailable, expired, or not configured. Contact the sender for help.
failed: This code could not be verified. Enter the newest code sent to the invited email address, or choose Send new code.
expired: This code has expired or has already been used. Choose Send new code and enter only the newest one.
sendFailed: The verification email could not be sent. Your invitation is unchanged. Please try again.
rateLimited: Please wait a minute before requesting another code. Use the newest code already in your inbox.
missing: Open the private invitation link from your Artanrecords invitation email. This page cannot identify your agreement without that link; a sign-in code alone is not an invitation.
accessFailed: Your email is verified, but the agreement could not be opened. Try Open agreement again; you do not need another verification code.
connectionFailed: We could not reach the verification service. Check your connection and try again.
linkFailed: This email link has expired or has already been used. Open your original private invitation email to request a new code.
resumeFailed: Your email is verified. Open the original private invitation link to choose the agreement you want to review; no Studio access has been granted.
detailsNotice: Enter your contracting details. After submission, they are locked for review.
signatureHelp: Signature upload appears here after Artanrecords reviews your legal details and offers an agreement. Open the offered document, follow the section guide, then choose Draw, Type or Upload at the signature step. There is no document to sign yet.
